title: Project checks
description: Commands that verify the project's own rules, such as its tests or linters. Principles name them in their checks, next to fausto's built-in checks. They run only where the project's code may run (fausto check -commands, as in CI), never on fausto's server.

id.description: Name principles use; it may not be a built-in check's name or review.

run.description: Shell command (sh -c); exit status 0 means it passes.

dir.description: Directory to run it in, relative to the repository root (default: the root).

timeout.description: Longest it may run, such as 90s or 10m (default: 10m).
